scope.artifact_bytes: Canonical serialized per-run evidence before insertion of this byte-count field; excludes the enclosing source/reference report and duplicate SQL log files.
scope.claims: Finite actual-SQL cross-branch conflict and shared permit accounting only. No LGGR superiority, cochain interpretation, or held-out generalization claim.
scope.concurrency: Two independent executor threads rendezvous before each transform; observed transform-call overlap is reported, not assumed.
scope.cost_units: One shared permit per issued branch transform including local validation, integration, or join guard. Static proposal construction and host bookkeeping are uncharged; independent reference subprocess cost is reported separately.
scope.policies: A uses branch-local validation. B/C are identical complete supplemental SQL guards; these are explicit local policy adapters, not frozen controller evaluation runs.
scope.runtime: Deterministic host proposals and real concurrent SQLite transforms; no live model/API calls.
scope.timing_provenance: Design requested before held-out evaluation; supplemental execution occurred after it. No production sources or controller policies were changed.
scope.trace_instrumentation: Process-local sqlite3.connect wrapper installs trace callbacks; existing tool source and SQL results are unchanged.
